page_title: MAL 1-1 CEL | Mallorca v Celta Vigo 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Dani Rodriguez (Mallorca) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+4' A cross from a corner kick by Mallorca is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+3' Mallorca are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Pablo Duran will be replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo).
90' Marc Domenech (Mallorca) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
89' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.

87' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
85' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
83' The attendance for today's match is 16274.
82' Substitution. Jan Salas (Mallorca) on for Pablo Torre.
82' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
81' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
80' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Guzman saw the whole situation.
80' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
78' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Leo Roman comes off the line to clear the ball away.
76' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
74' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) gets booked for the first time in this match.
73' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Ferran Jutgla and he is replaced by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).
73' Substitution. Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) in, Hugo Sotelo out.
71' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) brings an opponent down and Jose Guzman interrupts the game. A free kick has been awarded to Mallorca.
71' Booking. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) receives a caution from the referee.
68' Substitution. Takuma Asano is replaced by Marc Domenech (Mallorca).
68' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Rodriguez (Mallorca) replacing Omar Mascarell.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mateo Joseph trots off the pitch and is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
67' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
67' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Guzman signals. It's a free kick to Mallorca in a dangerous position.
66' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
63' Here is a change. Manuel Fernandez is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
63' The game has come to an end for Iago Aspas. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
62' Jose Guzman blows the whistle, Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) is penalised for a foul. Celta Vigo are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Johan Mojica (Mallorca).
60' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
58' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Johan Mojica (Mallorca), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a throw-in.
56' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) gets a yellow card.
55' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
54' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
51' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) earns the yellow card.

50' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
48' Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down. Jose Guzman has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca will take a free kick near the side line.
47' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Substitution. Antonio Sanchez makes his way off the pitch and Marash Kumbulla (Mallorca) comes on as his replacement.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

44' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jose Guzman blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick to Celta Vigo.

41' The cross into the penalty area from Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

38' What a goal that is! Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) received the ball on the edge of the 18-yard box and spotted the goalkeeper off his line. He set himself up perfectly and lobbed the ball over Leo Roman and into the net. Hugo Sotelo provided the assistance. 0:1.
36' Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.

35' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
32' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
32' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the left post.
32' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
30' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
28' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Mallorca have a free kick.
28' Poor challenge! Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is penalised for tripping and Jose Guzman blows his whistle. Mallorca win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
27' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
26' Chance! Pablo Torre (Mallorca) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.

23' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
22' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a long ball in, but Ionut Radu comfortably gathers the ball.
21' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but Ionut Radu punches the ball away.
20' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
17' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
17' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

16' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Leo Roman sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner. The linesman makes the right call and Celta Vigo will have a corner.
15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
14' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
14' Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul after Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) hacks down one of his opponents.
11' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
10' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
9' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Ionut Radu stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
8' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

4' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
3' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
Jose Guzman will supervise the game today.
